I lead the team behind Kraken Phone, a real-time telephony and voice AI platform, and I'm accountable for its reliability, on-call and incident response. I have 5+ years of experience managing engineers, a background in developer ecosystems (Twilio, and PokéAPI at 10B+ requests a month), and I now build with MCP and LLM agents.

## Experience

### Kraken Tech — *Lead Software Engineer, Kraken Phone*
London UK · Energy retail operating platform · Jan 2024 – Present

I lead engineering for Kraken Phone, the contact-centre telephony and voice AI platform used by energy retailers in Europe, Japan and North America.

- **Promoted** to Lead in Oct 2025. I manage a 6-person backend team, set the roadmap with product, run performance reviews and coach engineers through promotion.
- **Led Subscription Profiles** from proposal to GA (Apr 2026): wrote the designs, broke the work down for ~9 engineers and saw it through to flag removal.
- **Own operational rigour** for a business-critical real-time service: SEV-1/2 incident lead, on-call rota, postmortems. Moved the team to incident.io and rebuilt alert routing across ~500 Datadog monitors.
- **Distributed systems** built on Twilio, Ably, AWS and our own call-routing engine, with client teams in many time zones.
- **AI and agentic systems:** prototyped an LLM caller brief, built an MCP tool for AI agents, and introduced AI-assisted incident triage.

### Sharesies — *Technical Lead & People Manager*
Wellington NZ · Financial markets and wealth platform · Mar 2020 – Dec 2023

- **People manager** for the Operator Efficiency team. Built a brand new team into one of the most productive in the company and mentored every direct report through promotion.
- **Delivered** two-factor authentication and automated withdrawal verification, which cut manual work by 92%.
- **Led** internal platform work: operator roles and permissions, React for Sharesies Admin, and hundreds of page performance improvements.
